name: Shadcn Fintech
summary: Open-source fintech dashboard template with 11 pages, built on Next.js 16, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4.
description: A complete banking and crypto dashboard app: overview, accounts, transactions table, transfers, 3D credit cards, analytics with a spending heatmap, live investment ticker, budgets and settings. Dashboard widgets are drag-and-drop; auth pages use Clerk with an animated 3D globe; dark mode throughout.
contains: 11 built pages plus sign-in and sign-up
candlestick crypto chart, 8-coin market overview and trade form
drag-and-drop dashboard widgets persisted to localStorage
3D flip credit cards with freeze toggle and virtual card generator
budget progress rings and savings goals
MIT license; Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4, Recharts, Motion
